# planner model bake-off
Exploratory comparison.

planner-lite vs planner-pro · plan_delivery_round

**Exploratory: planner-pro and planner-lite ran 3 cases each; no grader here says pass or fail; too few cases to call a difference.**

## Scorecard

plan_delivery_round has no pass rate: no grader there says pass or fail, so its readings are read on their own.

Every arm ran each case twice on plan_delivery_round.

## Design & provenance

**Test setup**

| Disclosure | Detail | Aspects |
|---|---|---|
| Cost as routed | Each cost figure reflects the provider routing of the runs it was measured on, not the model alone. | plan_delivery_round |

## plan_delivery_round

no grader here says pass or fail.

<details><summary>plan_delivery_round in full</summary>

planner-lite vs planner-pro · plan_delivery_round · 30 Oct 2026 · 3 cases × 2 repeats

**Scoreboard**

| Arm | Ran | Usable | Cost per 1,000 replies |
|---|---|---|---|
| planner-lite | 6 | 6 | $2.00 |
| planner-pro | 6 | 6 | $2.00 |

Usable cases: planner-l
